parts.name: battery_h6
sources: The battery H6, 70 Ah, 610 CCA (Ford, 2022 Transit Body and Equipment Mounting Manual, page 87), under the floor of the driver: 20.4 kg (an AGM battery of that size, a retailer).

parts.name: body_ford_transit
sources: The front door: its seam at 1.27 m behind the front axle and its window from x 0.10 to 1.16 m (the photos and renders of dealers, transit_passenger notes). Its front edge over the arch of the wheel and its bottom at 0.42 m: by eye from the same photos.
The sliding door: 1300 by 1601 mm (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022), from 1.3 m behind the front axle; the door is from 0.42 to 2.36 m (the photos of dealers).

The rear doors: from the lamps at the back (0.095 m in from the side) to the middle, from 0.71 m (over the bumper) to 0.05 m over the opening, which is 1887 mm (high roof) or 1648 mm (medium roof) high from the floor (Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022; the photos of dealers).

parts.name: cab_transit
sources: The dash and the steering wheel: by eye from the photos of the inside of a 2026 Transit passenger van (https://www.comvoy.com/work-van/fenton-mi/new-2026-ford-transit-350-xl-passenger-van-25226733).

parts.name: details_transit
sources: The vents of the hood and the rail of the sliding door at 1.45 m: from the photos of dealers.

parts.name: engine_bay_transit
sources: The air box, the coolant reservoir, the fuse box and the brake reservoir: from the photos of the bay of a 2022 Transit.

parts.name: engine_ford_3_5_v6
sources: The 3.5 L V6 of the Transit, along the van: its size and its belt by eye, from photos of the bay.
The mass: 189 kg dry, with no accessory drive (Ford Performance, the 3.5 L EcoBoost crate engine; the 3.5 L PFDi of the van is near it: an estimate), and 5 kg of oil (5.7 L).

sources: A radiator of about 1.1 by 0.5 m with its fan shroud: by eye; 10 kg with its coolant (an estimate).
